property_summary: After calling XBornID() and then getTokens() by a non-blacklisted user when totalRemaining is 500000e18 and value is initially 1000e18, the reference contract sets value to (1000e18 / 100000) * 99999 = 999990000000000000000 while the buggy contract sets value to 99999, causing a subsequent getTokens() call to succeed in the reference (distributing 999990000000000000000 tokens) but in the buggy contract the distributed amount is only 99999, leading to a different balanceOf for the caller.
change_summary: Remove the division in the final value assignment so value = 99999 instead of the decreasing amount
